title: feat(urlSync): url generation for widget links. Fix #29
body:
## User POV

The urlSync is not a widget anymore and is now activated by the presence of the urlSync config object in the parameters of the instantSearch. Widget should implement the URL link feature.

## Dev POV

This feature allow widget implementers to generate url for the changes to happen. This provide a createURL function as part of the rendering arguments. This is bound to the filtering and type of URL's.

The Template has been modified to be able to pass contextual data computed from the other components or widgets.
